A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HIV-specific CD4+ CTLs do not cause HIV-associated immunopathology by killing bystander cells.
CTL lysis of HIV-infected cells is by granule exocytic pathway and that HIV-infected cells can also lyse bystander cells by fas-mediated pathway.

The main takeaway from our work is that
HIV-specific CTL kill HIV-infected targets by the granule-mediated pathway, but not via the fas pathway.
CTL do not kill bystander cells by fas pathway activation, but that HIV-infected cells can kill bystander cells.
HIV-specific cytotoxic T cells do not cause HIV-associated immunopathology.
